detail.longDescription: The Register: Black Hat and DEF CON are AI conferences now, too. “Our cybersecurity editor Jessica Lyons spent last week in Las Vegas for the Black Hat and DEF CON security conferences, and at both events there was only one thing on everyone’s mind: AI agents and their growing threat to cybersecurity defenders.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/08/20/the-register-black-hat-and-def-con-are-ai-conferences-now-too/
